BSP-Core Reference Sheet

32 plates: every machine with its build layout and finished look, the totem extras, every block and item, every recipe, and how each metal and coin is made. Each plate is also saved as an image for CurseForge.

Single-block machines

BSP-Core

Tetrium Crucible

Smelts one Tetrium Ore into 2 Tetrium Nuggets and 1 Tetrium Slag in 20 seconds. Burns furnace fuel.

Combination Forge

Presses nine nuggets into an ingot (Tetrium, Magnatite, and Illyrium with the Illyrium Forge Upgrade) and Tetrium Ingots into Tetrium Plates. Runs on fuel, or on RF with an RF Upgrade.

Illyrium Crucible (3 x 3 x 3)

BSP-Core

Build it

Each grid is one layer seen from above. The bottom row of a grid is the front of the machine.

  • 12 x Illyrium Casing
  • 8 x Lava Pylon
  • 2 x Item Hatch
  • 1 x Illyrium Core
  • 1 x Illyrium Crucible Controller

Finished

Runs on lava. Smelts Illyrium Ore with slag into Dirty Illyrium Ingots, and alloys Pure Illyrium Dust with Tetrium Dust into Illyrium Nuggets. Lower pylons take lava, upper pylons take RF.

Sneak + right-click the controller in game for the step-by-step Assembly Guide.

Illyrium Refinery

BSP-Core

Build it

Each grid is one layer seen from above. The bottom row of a grid is the front of the machine.

  • 8 x Illyrium Casing
  • 1 x Item Hatch
  • 1 x Illyrium Core
  • 2 x Illyrium Tank Glass
  • 1 x Refinery Pump
  • 1 x Illyrium Refinery Controller

Finished

Washes Dirty Illyrium Dust into Pure Illyrium Dust with water and a filter. The pump takes water and RF; the Item Hatch takes dust in and pure dust out.

Sneak + right-click the controller in game for the step-by-step Assembly Guide.

Shatter Coin Factory (one slice: 1 x 2 x 3)

BSP-Core

Build it

Each grid is one layer seen from above. The bottom row of a grid is the front of the machine.

  • 1 x Factory Blank Hatch
  • 2 x Factory Frame
  • 1 x Shatter Coin Factory Controller
  • 1 x Factory Power Port
  • 1 x Factory Press

Mo Up to three Motivators on top of a slice cut its press time by 15%, 30% and 50%.

Finished

Presses coin blanks into Shatter Coins in real time, from 12 hours for Copper to 7 days for Illyrium. Needs RF. Up to 10 slices side by side join into one machine.

Sneak + right-click the controller in game for the step-by-step Assembly Guide.

Magnetic Centrifuge (1 x 3 x 3, stackable)

BSP-Core

Build it

Each grid is one layer seen from above. The bottom row of a grid is the front of the machine.

  • 13 x Centrifuge Casing
  • 2 x Centrifuge Rotor
  • 1 x Centrifuge Power Port
  • 1 x Item Hatch
  • 1 x Magnetic Centrifuge Controller

Finished

Always needs RF. Separates Magnatite Ore into nuggets and Carbon Dust, and with a Copper Tetrium Coil charges Magnatite Ingots. More layers give more nuggets and a better charge chance.

Sneak + right-click the controller in game for the step-by-step Assembly Guide.

Wave Plasma: the network

BSP-Core

Totem on an extractor, interfaces beside it, cables out to a Projector Base with its Projector, and a second run into the back of a Battery Charger. A valve and a repeater sit in the long run.

How it flows

A placed totem gives 100 mB/t, up to 6,000 with the Output upgrade. An interface shares it equally between the runs leaving it, up to 1,000 mB/t a face, and a run is held to its weakest cable.

CableRunCarries
Ca Tetrium Plasma Cable15 blocks250 mB/t
Ca Magnatite Plasma Cable25 blocks500 mB/t
Ca Illyrium Plasma Cable40 blocks1,000 mB/t
Ca Charged Illyrium Plasma Cable80 blocks1,000 mB/t

A repeater starts a fresh run for a tenth of the pressure. A valve caps a run at up to 1,000 mB/t or shuts it by redstone. A projector needs 100 mB/t; its base holds 5,000 mB.

Right-click any interface for the flow view: the whole network in 3D with the mB/t on every cable. Jade reads the figures block by block.

The plasma blocks

BSP-Core

Extractor and interfaces

Touching interfaces join into one body, up to twelve. A thirteenth, or one touching an extractor another group holds, turns red and does nothing.

Projector Base

A tank the projector stands on. Cables plug into its sides; the level shows through its windows.

Plasma Valve

Sets the most that may pass, from its screen. A lever on it or any redstone signal shuts it. The wheel turns with the limit.

Plasma Repeater

One way: in through the dark back, out through the lit front. Starts a fresh run. The wrench turns it.

Powers pass a valve unchanged. Behind a repeater a projector receives one power at full level, or several each a level lower per repeater.

Batteries, cells and the Wave Emitter

BSP-Core

Battery Charger

Cable into its back. Fills the battery or cell standing in it and stamps powers from the interface into it, chosen on its screen.

Wave Emitter, Power Cells, Wrench

The emitter runs on a cell in your offhand and gives you its Carried powers at 20 mB/t. Right-click at the air to open it.

Plasma Batteries

Four tiers. Stood on an extractor instead of a totem, a battery feeds it with its stamped Base powers until it runs dry.

TierHoldsPowers
Battery I to IV40k / 200k / 1M / 5M mB0 / 2 / 3 / 4 Base
Cell I to III8k / 24k / 60k mB1 / 2 / 3 Carried
Every battery and cell is built around a Charged Resonance Crystal: a Resonance Crystal magnetised in the centrifuge with a Magnatite Nugget in the upgrade slot.

Coloured cables and cable ends

BSP-Core

Sixteen colours

Magnatite, Illyrium and Charged Illyrium cables take any dye: eight cables round a dye, and dye again to change. A coloured cable joins only its own colour and a plain one only plain ones, so runs can cross without mixing. Machines take any colour.

Wrench-set ends

Point the wrench at an end of a cable and right-click to set it: Normal, Output (plasma only leaves there, copper collar and arrow out), Input (only enters, arrow in), Off (a plate, not joined), or Linked where another colour meets it (copper and white collar). A line above the crosshair names the end and its setting. Sneak + right-click: back to Normal; on the core, pick the cable up with its settings.

One Output end at a base stops a loop feeding back; an Input end on a shared trunk stops a run drawing from the wrong side.

Decoy Totem

BSP-Core

What its owner sees

The Hollow Idol on its Decoy Power Base, with a faint ghost of the totem around it.

What everyone else sees

An ordinary Shatter Totem. Rival Totem Compasses within range point at it. Try to steal it and its traps go off.

Needs 100 RF per tick. Five per player. Sockets: Range Coils, trap charges, a Trap Amplifier, Reinforced Casings.

Coin Vault and Anti Totem Block

BSP-Core

Coin Vault, joined

Vault blocks of one owner join into one vault of up to 3 x 3 x 3. Coins inside earn interest. Others can pick the lock for a quarter of the coins.

Anti Totem Block (admins)

Keeps Shatter Totems and chosen BSP blocks out of a box of up to 256 blocks in each direction. For spawn areas, hubs and arenas.
